scenarios.title: Nominal preflight
scenarios.description: Disarmed vehicle with healthy sensors before takeoff.

scenarios.title: Nominal landed state
scenarios.description: Vehicle is disarmed and landed.

scenarios.title: Nominal takeoff
scenarios.description: Positive climb immediately after arming.

scenarios.title: Nominal climb
scenarios.description: Healthy climb within vertical-speed limits.

scenarios.title: Nominal cruise
scenarios.description: All flight-state inputs are within the configured envelope.

scenarios.title: Nominal approach
scenarios.description: Vehicle is descending near the goal with a clear landing zone.

scenarios.title: Nominal landing
scenarios.description: Controlled descent over a confirmed clear landing zone.

scenarios.title: GPS quality loss
scenarios.description: GPS quality drops below the critical threshold.

scenarios.title: Estimator unhealthy
scenarios.description: PX4 estimator health becomes false.

scenarios.title: Stale telemetry
scenarios.description: Synchronized telemetry exceeds the freshness budget.

scenarios.title: Battery return reserve
scenarios.description: Battery reaches the configured return reserve.

scenarios.title: Battery landing reserve
scenarios.description: Battery reaches the configured landing reserve.

scenarios.title: Communication link loss
scenarios.description: Link quality drops below the configured minimum.

scenarios.title: Near geofence boundary
scenarios.description: Vehicle is inside but close to the geofence boundary.

scenarios.title: Geofence breach
scenarios.description: Vehicle position is outside the approved geofence.

scenarios.title: Route deviation
scenarios.description: Vehicle deviates materially from the validated A* route.

scenarios.title: Calibrated obstacle TTC
scenarios.description: Depth and tracking produce a critical time-to-collision.

scenarios.title: Terrain clearance violation
scenarios.description: Current altitude is below the minimum terrain clearance.

scenarios.title: Excessive attitude tilt
scenarios.description: Roll exceeds the configured analysis envelope.

scenarios.title: Excessive ground speed
scenarios.description: Ground speed exceeds the configured envelope.

scenarios.title: Excessive descent rate
scenarios.description: Vertical descent rate exceeds the configured envelope.

scenarios.title: Takeoff without climb
scenarios.description: Takeoff phase exceeds its time budget without altitude gain.

scenarios.title: Landing zone blocked
scenarios.description: Approach/landing is active but the landing zone is not clear.

scenarios.title: Camera stream loss
scenarios.description: GStreamer camera health becomes false.

scenarios.title: Tracker unavailable
scenarios.description: YOLO tracker health becomes false and TTC cannot be trusted.

scenarios.title: Stale uploaded map
scenarios.description: Uploaded map exceeds its configured age limit.

scenarios.title: Illegal phase transition
scenarios.description: A landing phase is followed directly by cruise.
